text:
Chris: Hey all, quick onboarding check: when does benefits kick in if I start 4/28? Also I need to submit moving receipts and request a small moving advance. Who do I send those to?

Maya (People Ops): Welcome, Chris! :wave: Benefits effective date is usually the 1st of the month after 30 days. So starting 4/28 -> coverage starts 6/1. You can enroll in the benefits portal within a few days of your account provisioning.

Liam (Benefits): Adding: you have a 30-day enrollment window. If you have a lapse of coverage right before start, we can request retro coverage from the carrier—upload proof (COBRA end date, etc.) in the portal and tag "retro". HSA/FSA elections are done during enrollment; HSA requires choosing the HSA-eligible medical plan.

Chris: Got it. For the advance and receipts: do I email payroll or finance? Any particular subject line?

Ava (Payroll): Email payroll@redwood.example to request an advance, and cc finance@redwood.example and your manager. Subject: "ADVANCE - Moving - Chris - <offerID>". We'll need manager approval. Once approved, advances disburse next business day and are recouped over the following 2 pay periods by default. Submit receipts via Expensely and choose expense type "Relocation".

Chris: Thanks. One more: holiday eligibility if I start mid-week? Do I get the observed company holiday that week?

Maya (People Ops): Company-observed holidays apply from day one. If a holiday falls during your start week, you will be paid for that observed holiday. PTO accrual is pro-rated and shown in your onboarding checklist.

Onboard Bot: Checklist completed: I-9 verification pending. Link: https://onboard.redwood.example/checklist/chr-1772

Chris: Perfect, that clears it up. I'll upload receipts and submit the advance request today. Thanks! :thumbsup:
